description: This Java class defines a REST controller for handling HTTP requests related to predefined bookshelves in a book-tracking application. It provides endpoints to retrieve books from specific predefined shelves such as "to-read", "reading", "read", and "did-not-finish" by invoking methods on the BookService.

classes.name: PredefinedShelfController
classes.description: A Spring REST controller that provides endpoints to retrieve books from predefined shelves.

methods.name: getAllToReadBooks
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve all books in the 'To Read' predefined shelf.

methods.name: getAllReadingBooks
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve all books in the 'Reading' predefined shelf.

methods.name: getAllReadBooks
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve all books in the 'Read' predefined shelf.

methods.name: getAllDidNotFinishBooks
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve all books in the 'Did Not Finish' predefined shelf.
